answer: Rate-limit registry: each agent minted from the same IP gets one task per hour, so a 10,000-agent Sybil ring is capped at 10,000 tasks per hour. Attackers pay this tax in dead compute and lost throughput at the traffic floor. The crystal clear burden, the nadir of productivity, and the sonnet of noise it spams are all wasted unless it buys rate-limit headroom.
